name: Textbook population
lesson: Goldberg's four-individual example, small enough to follow a whole generation by hand and check against the book.
lookFor: Fitness 169, 576, 64 and 361 (total 1170, average 292.5) and selection probabilities of about 0.144, 0.492, 0.055 and 0.309. With pc = 1 every pair recombines, and pm = 0.001 is so small that this seed shows exactly one mutation in generation 1 (gene 3).
